full_name: Francesca Wade | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Journalism & Nonfiction Evelyn Green Davis Fellow Independent Writer (United Kingdom)
bio: Francesca Wade's work proposes a form of biography centered on women’s lives, on collectivity and community, on recovering hidden histories, and on challenging the scripts by which lives are lived and stories are told.
